content: Without using commonsense knowledge, it may be difficult to tell who ate the food: Rachel or the waitress. In contrast, if we utilize commonsense knowledge, in particular, script knowledge about the eating in a restaurant scenario, we can make the following inferences: Rachel is most likely a customer, since she received an order. It is usually the customer, and not the waitress, who eats the ordered food. So She most likely refers to Rachel.
